you_should_know.title: Staples Police Department deactivated by state; Guadalupe County deputies take over calls
you_should_know.summary: City leaders dispute some of the findings from TCOLE, the Texas Commission on Law Enforcement, and say they had no opportunity to appeal. Amended state standards governing police agencies take effect Sept. 1.

you_should_know.title: 'Don't you touch me' | Balcones Heights mayor released on bond after arrest following heated council meeting
you_should_know.summary: Johnny Rodriguez, mayor of Balcones Heights, a small city surrounded by San Antonio about five miles northwest of downtown, was released on bond after his arrest on an assault charge.
